fullPassage: Don’t Lose Your Language! Did you know that there are over 7,000 languages currently being used around the world? Most of these languages are spoken by very small groups of people, and half of them could disappear within the next generation. This would be a great loss because language plays a big role in connecting people’s identity to their culture. This is why some organizations work to preserve them. For example, a nonprofit organization called Wikitongues has set the goal of preserving all languages that are in danger of being lost. The organization works to achieve this by recording videos of individuals speaking these languages and making mother-tongue resources more accessible.
